name: node test mock timers fire in due order with the clock at the tick end
source: import { mock } from 'node:test'; function main(): void { const out: string[] = []; const log = (...a: any[]): void => { out.push(a.map((x: any): string => typeof x === 'string' ? x : JSON.stringify(x)).join(' ')); }; mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['setTimeout', 'setInterval', 'setImmediate', 'Date'], now: 1000 }); log('enabled', Date.now(), new Date().getTime(), typeof Date()); const t: any = setTimeout((a: string, b: string): void => log('timeout', a, b, Date.now()), 100, 'x', 'y'); log(typeof t, t.constructor.name, typeof t.ref, typeof t.hasRef, t.hasRef(), typeof t[Symbol.toPrimitive]); let n = 0; const iv: any = setInterval((): void => { log('iv', ++n, Date.now()); if (n === 3) clearInterval(iv); }, 50); const imm: any = setImmediate((): void => log('imm', Date.now())); log(imm.constructor.name); const t2 = setTimeout((): void => log('cancelled'), 10); clearTimeout(t2); mock.timers.tick(49); log('after49'); mock.timers.tick(1); log('after50'); mock.timers.tick(50); log('after100'); mock.timers.tick(100); log('after200'); setTimeout((): void => log('nested1'), 10); setTimeout((): void => { log('nested2'); setTimeout((): void => log('nested3'), 5); }, 10); mock.timers.runAll(); log('runAll now', Date.now()); let k = 0; const iv2: any = setInterval((): void => { k++; }, 10); mock.timers.runAll(); log('runAll interval k', k); clearInterval(iv2); const args: number[] = []; setTimeout((...xs: number[]): void => { args.push(xs.length); }, 1, 1, 2, 3); mock.timers.tick(1); log('args', args.join(',')); const cleared: number[] = []; const ci: any = setInterval((): void => { cleared.push(Date.now()); }, 5); mock.timers.tick(12); clearInterval(ci); mock.timers.tick(20); log('interval cleared', cleared.join(',')); mock.timers.reset(); console.log(out.join('|')); }
